author: vendor-examples builder (slack)
about: Slack's published Web API examples (the responses in spec/openapi.json.gz), replayed in Juniper, a design studio's workspace, over its spring launch: its members, its bot and its org admin, identity provider and sign-in apps installed with the scopes their calls need, and each example's precondition made true by the steps before it. Each refusal comes from a cause the steps make true; invalid_auth is a deploy that sent its app's signing secret as its token.

exampleDiffers.usergroups[].user_count: The example writes user_count as text ("user_count" : "2") here but as a number in the same group object on usergroups.update's page ("user_count" : 1, https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/usergroups.update); a count is a number.

notReplayed.files_comments_delete#200 application/js: A file comment to delete cannot be made: "On May 22nd, 2019, files.comments.add and files.comments.edit will cease functioning. You won't be able to add or edit file comments." (https://docs.slack.dev/changelog/2019/02/01/cemented-fate-for-file-comments). Only a comment made before 2019 could be deleted, and no World made through Slack's API since holds one.
